segments.name: Real Estate Debt
segments.description: Originates, acquires and asset-manages commercial real estate debt and real estate securities for its own portfolio.
segments.evidence: The real estate debt business focuses on originating, acquiring and asset managing commercial real estate debt investments, including first mortgages, subordinate mortgages, mezzanine loans and participations in such loans.

segments.name: Agency Business
segments.description: Originates, sells and services agency mortgage loans for GSEs and Agencies, and services external portfolios of commercial real estate financing products.
segments.evidence: The Agency Business focuses on originating, selling, and servicing loans under programs offered by GSE's and Agencies, such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae, and HUD.

segments.name: Conduit
segments.description: Originates fixed-rate commercial real estate loans and sells them into the CMBS securitization market at a profit.
segments.evidence: The commercial real estate conduit business, operated through the Company's TRS, is focused on generating risk-adjusted returns by originating and subsequently selling fixed-rate commercial real estate loans into the CMBS securitization market at a profit.

segments.name: Real Estate Owned
segments.description: Holds real estate acquired through foreclosure, deed-in-lieu of foreclosure or purchase, and earns rental income from those properties.
segments.evidence: The real estate owned business represents real estate acquired by the Company through foreclosure, deed-in-lieu of foreclosure, or purchase.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on commercial real estate loans, and agency loans are sold for gains with servicing fee income.
revenueModel.evidence: Net interest income is generated on our interest-earning assets less related interest-bearing liabilities and is recorded as part of our real estate debt, real estate securities, agency and conduit programs.

changes.text: The Agency Business became a new business segment after the Company acquired NewPoint in 2025.
changes.evidence: On July 1, 2025, through a wholly owned subsidiary, the Company acquired NewPoint Holdings JV LLC ("NewPoint"), which now comprises the Company's Agency Business unit.
